select sr.id, sr.user_id, sr.emp_name, su.user_type, em.phone_no, tde.depart_name, sr.valid_period, sr.emp_no, em.email, em.org_name, sr.user_name, tde.power_factory_name, tde.role_name, sr.remark, sr.update_time, sr.status, sr.update_source from ytsafety_sys_responsible sr inner join safety_sys_user su on sr.user_id = su.id inner join safety_employee_message em on em.emp_no = sr.emp_no left join ( select m.user_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct m.depart_name SEPARATOR ',') AS depart_name, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct m.role_name SEPARATOR ',') AS role_name, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct m.factory_name SEPARATOR ',') AS power_factory_name from ytsafety_sys_responsible_mapping m group by m.user_id ) tde on sr.user_id = tde.user_id where sr.del_flag = 0 and su.delete_falg = 0
AND sr.user_id IN ( select m.user_id from ytsafety_sys_responsible_mapping m where m.depart_path LIKE CONCAT(#{dto.departPath}, '%'))
AND sr.user_id IN ( select m.user_id from ytsafety_sys_responsible_mapping m where FIND_IN_SET(m.factory_id, #{dto.belongFactoryId}))
AND sr.user_id IN ( select m.user_id from ytsafety_sys_responsible_mapping m where FIND_IN_SET(m.role_id, #{dto.roleId}))
AND em.emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{dto.empName},'%')
AND em.emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{dto.empNo},'%')
AND em.phone_no like CONCAT('%',#{dto.phone},'%')
AND su.user_type = #{dto.userType}
order by sr.update_time desc

select sr.id, sr.user_id, sr.emp_name, su.user_type, su.user_name, em.phone_no phone, tde.depart_id, sr.valid_period, sr.emp_no, em.email, em.org_name, sr.user_name, tde.power_factory_id, tde.role_id, sr.remark, sr.update_time, sr.status, sr.update_source from ytsafety_sys_responsible sr inner join ( select sr.id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct sud.depart_id SEPARATOR ',') AS depart_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct suf.factory_id SEPARATOR ',') AS power_factory_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct sur.role_id SEPARATOR ',') AS role_id from ytsafety_sys_responsible sr left join safety_sys_user_role sur on sr.user_id = sur.user_id and sur.del_flag=0 and sur.role_type in(0,1) left join ytsafety_sys_user_depart sud on sud.user_id=sr.user_id left join ytsafety_sys_user_factory suf on sr.user_id=suf.user_id where sr.del_flag = 0 and sr.id=#{id} group by sr.id ) tde on sr.id=tde.id inner join safety_sys_user su on sr.user_id=su.id inner join safety_employee_message em on em.emp_no = su.emp_no where sr.del_flag = 0 and sr.id=#{id}

select sr.id, sr.user_id, sr.emp_name, su.user_type, su.user_name, em.phone_no phone, tde.depart_id, sr.valid_period, sr.emp_no, em.email, em.org_name, sr.user_name, tde.power_factory_id, tde.role_id, sr.remark, sr.update_time, sr.status, sr.update_source from ytsafety_sys_responsible sr inner join ( select sr.id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct sud.depart_id SEPARATOR ',') AS depart_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct suf.factory_id SEPARATOR ',') AS power_factory_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct sur.role_id SEPARATOR ',') AS role_id from ytsafety_sys_responsible sr left join safety_sys_user_role sur on sr.user_id = sur.user_id and sur.del_flag=0 and sur.role_type in(0,1) left join ytsafety_sys_user_depart sud on sud.user_id=sr.user_id left join ytsafety_sys_user_factory suf on sr.user_id=suf.user_id where sr.del_flag = 0 and sr.emp_no=#{empNo} group by sr.id ) tde on sr.id=tde.id inner join safety_sys_user su on sr.user_id=su.id inner join safety_employee_message em on em.emp_no = su.emp_no where sr.del_flag = 0 and sr.emp_no=#{empNo}

select su.id,su.id user_id, em.emp_name, su.user_type, em.phone_no, tde.depart_id, em.emp_no, em.email, em.org_name, em.emp_login user_name, tde.power_factory_id, tde.role_id from safety_sys_user su left join ( select su.id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct sud.depart_id SEPARATOR ',') AS depart_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct suf.factory_id SEPARATOR ',') AS power_factory_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct sur.role_id SEPARATOR ',') AS role_id from safety_sys_user su left join safety_sys_user_role sur on su.id = sur.user_id and sur.del_flag=0 and sur.role_type in(0,1) left join ytsafety_sys_user_depart sud on sud.user_id=su.id left join ytsafety_sys_user_factory suf on su.id=suf.user_id where su.delete_falg=0 and su.emp_no=#{empNo} group by su.id ) tde on su.id=tde.id inner join safety_employee_message em on em.emp_no = su.emp_no where su.delete_falg=0 and su.emp_no=#{empNo}

select su.id,su.id user_id, em.emp_name, em.phone_no, tde.depart_id, em.emp_no, em.email, em.org_name, em.emp_login user_name, tde.power_factory_id, tde.role_id, (case when jrm.is_security>=1 then 1 else 0 end) as user_type from safety_employee_message em left join safety_sys_user su on em.emp_no = su.emp_no left join (select job_code,count(1) is_security from ytsafety_sys_job_role_mapping where del_flag=0 group by job_code) jrm on jrm.job_code=em.position_code left join ( select su.id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct sud.depart_id SEPARATOR ',') AS depart_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct suf.factory_id SEPARATOR ',') AS power_factory_id, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct sur.role_id SEPARATOR ',') AS role_id from safety_sys_user su left join safety_sys_user_role sur on su.id = sur.user_id and sur.del_flag=0 and sur.role_type in(0,1) left join ytsafety_sys_user_depart sud on sud.user_id=su.id left join ytsafety_sys_user_factory suf on su.id=suf.user_id where su.delete_falg=0 group by su.id ) tde on su.id=tde.id where em.emp_login is not null and em.emp_no in
#{empNo}
